verdict.rationale: Drata documents a hosted trust center. Evidence covers SafeBase Trust Center branding and URL setup, a Trust Center analytics dashboard, and programmatic trust-center management aimed at accelerating security reviews. The evidence is only titles and one-line descriptions, and none of it shows the specific elements in the story. Missing for 10: evidence of live control status display, certification/report sharing, click-through NDA gating, in-depth docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
